sloka: एता वाचो बहुविधाः श्रुत्वा लक्ष्मणभाषिताः ।सुमन्त्रः श्रद्धया प्राज्ञो वाक्यमेतदुवाच ह ।। ७.५०.९ ॥
transliteration: etā vāco bahuvidhāḥ śrutvā lakṣmaṇabhāṣitāḥ ।sumantraḥ śraddhayā prājño vākyametaduvāca ha ।। 7.50.9 ॥

translations.english: Having heard these various words spoken by Lakshmana, the wise Sumantra, with faith, indeed spoke this statement.
